a_before_b.rationale: Distinguishing between RAG and finetuning does not require knowing specific finetuning frameworks or tactics; one can understand the conceptual choice without knowing how to implement finetuning.

b_before_a.rationale: Identifying finetuning frameworks and tactics is not required to understand the conceptual difference between information-based and behavior-based failures that drives the RAG vs finetuning decision.
